_provenance.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, EIA-861 Annual Electric Power Industry Report — 2024 Sales, Revenue and Price summary, Table 5.C (Average Monthly Bill, Industrial sector, by state)
_provenance.vintage: 2024 (final annual EIA-861 data; most recent complete year)
_provenance.method: Downloaded xlsx via Python urllib, parsed with openpyxl; extracted 'Average Price (cents/kWh)' column for the 50 states + DC, skipping census-division and U.S. Total aggregate rows; values rounded to 2 decimals. Note: the legacy https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/state/avgprice_annual.xlsx file is stale (ends at 2020), so the current EIA-861 summary table was used instead. Puerto Rico is not published in this table. U.S. Total industrial avg for cross-check: 8.13 cents/kWh.
